metadata.case_name: PANG WAI HUNG v. MPC EXPRESS SERVICES COMPANY

injuries.description: The Plaintiff lost the upper right central, lateral incisors and canine and the lower right central incisor.
injuries.body_part: upper right central, lateral incisors and canine; lower right central incisor
source: The Plaintiff lost the upper right central, lateral incisors and canine and the lower right central incisor.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of hard dental tissues and pulp

injuries.description: Pulpal death of the upper left central incisor.
source: Another tooth, namely, the upper left central incisor has, according to Dr Bong, suffered pulpal death.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of hard dental tissues and pulp

injuries.description: Laceration on the lower chin which has healed with a scar noticeable at close distance.
source: There is a laceration on the lower chin which has healed and there is a scar which is noticeable at close distance.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

manifestations.description: Loss of multiple teeth (upper right central, lateral incisors and canine; lower right central incisor)
Pulpal death of the upper left central incisor
Scar on the lower chin noticeable at close distance

treatments_received: Root canal therapy of the tooth No.21 (recommended by Dr Bong)
Gold-bonded porcelain 8-unit bridge for teeth Nos.15 to 23 (recommended by Dr Bong)
treatments_future: Replacement of the bridge; costs for 3 sets of bridge allowed by the Court ("costs I would allow is $90,750 x 3 = $272,250")

losses.description: Loss of multiple front teeth including upper right central, lateral incisors and canine and the lower right central incisor; two other teeth chipped; pulpal death of the upper left central incisor.
Scar on the lower chin which is noticeable at close distance.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheung Lap Yan v. Siu Ching Kee
comparable_cases.injury_description: A woman had 4 teeth with fracture crowns and 2 had cracked crowns. Two teeth were extracted and reconstructed with porcelain crowns. She also suffered facial injuries.
